Transaction 3478782 aligns with the holder baseline, matching online channel, product C, and hotmail.com email from prior transaction 3043555 ($121.32), with zero confirmed fraud cases on this holder.
Card activity in the 14-day window around transaction 3478782 contains only 1 transaction, showing no card testing sequences, no burst velocity, and no other suspicious transactions.
Shared origin analysis for recipient email hotmail.com shows 1,396 transactions across 251 cards with a lift of 0.97, showing no anomalous concentration of fraud.
Prior closed case CC-4160 on card C11891-K1 occurred on 2016-09-30 under a different holder identity and device D000594, with no link to the current holder or transaction.
Closed cases CC-4158 and CC-2037 show that transactions flagged by high legacy risk scores without model or graph corroboration were confirmed legitimate and cleared.

case.summary: Transaction 3478782 ($292.36, online) on card C11891-K1 was flagged solely by an uncalibrated legacy risk score of 0.79. The calibrated second-generation model scored the transaction low at 0.115, and the purchase aligns with the cardholder's established history for product type, channel, and email domain. Graph analysis confirmed no velocity bursts, testing sequences, or fraud ring connections, and an earlier fraud case on the card involved an unrelated holder identity. The transaction is determined to be legitimate.
